searchText: can we get this merged cc <@892053833121923094> 🙏, when rpc-compat glamtserdam? Tagging <@194432762315407360> again because this touches hivechain+rpc-compat I'm trying to build a branch in execution-apis that contains all the PRs and fixes needed but it's a moving target with a lot of dependencies spread out Is the fork definition somewhat settled now? I usually delay making execution-apis tests for the next fork until it is somewhat stable and the chain can be loaded in production clients. It's kinda annoying if we have to keep remaking the tests for every EIP change when it touches blockhash I realize this can be a blocker because we really want to test the next stuff. So it might be time now, and also seems like not too many EIP changes will still happen I think there be bugs still, I tried to use the ethpandaops/glasterdam-7 branches to build hivechain in one of my PRs and the other clients refused to import the block. I opened an issue about it in the specs repo. 🤷🏻‍♂️ but I'm mostly fumbling around in the dark lol it should be time
